newsitem.title: USA: CBOT financial futures delayed one hour minimum.
newsitem.headline: CBOT financial futures delayed one hour minimum.

text.p: The opening of trading on Monday in Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) financial futures contracts wil be delayed by at least one hour, the CBOT said.
"Now it looks like it will be delayed by at least one hour before the phone system can be fixed," said a CBOT spokesman.
He said the exchange would give a 10-minute advance notice once it knows when its contracts will open.

The normal 0720 CDT/1220 GMT opening in contracts such as U.S. Treasury bond and note futures was delayed indefinitely on Monday by unspecified telephone problems. --Derivatives Desk 312-408-8750 E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
